concept_decisions: Concept supports unequal partly shared coarse margins and fine centers. Reduce oversized boulders to small varied gravel/clasts and avoid mathematically perfect isolated rings. Margins broad and diffuse; dense integral faceted clast-like relief eliminates overlapping coplanar rock skins. Five centers with unequal ellipticity and scalloped boundaries, sparse small particles within fine centers. No vegetation or mechanical walls.
